lines.zh: 我领着小的们走过草地
lines.en: I lead the little ones across the grass

lines.zh: 我的脚步很稳，不惊动它们
lines.en: My steps are steady, not startling them
I bring up the rear of the line

lines.zh: 我把脖子低下去看它们
lines.en: I lower my neck to check on them
I trample the grass flat with my feet
I look back as I walk
My tail sweeps slowly
I head for the water side
I let the young ones go first

lines.zh: 草地上一块石头，我绕了过去
lines.en: A stone in the grass — I walk around it.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩在泥上留下大印
lines.en: My feet leave big prints in the mud

lines.zh: 我慢慢地带着队伍过河
lines.en: I lead the line slowly across the stream

lines.zh: 我让小的走在我的影子里
lines.en: I let the young walk in my shadow

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但一直不停
lines.en: I walk very slowly, but never stop
I stand with my neck curved

lines.zh: 我一会儿看孩子，一会儿看草
lines.en: I look at the young, then at the grass.
I count how many young ones there are
I crouch so they can lean in
My back is broad enough to block wind
The wind moves the skin of my neck

lines.zh: 我把一只小的推到队伍里
lines.en: I nudge a small one back into line
I look down at the ground
I listen for movement in the grass
I lift one leg slowly

lines.zh: 我把头搁在一根横枝上
lines.en: I rest my head on a low branch
I lie down, legs folded under me
I look up; the clouds are drifting south.

lines.zh: 我等最慢的那只赶上来
lines.en: I wait for the slowest one to catch up
You are standing beside my young
Step back a little

lines.zh: 我的脖子能低下来护住它们
lines.en: My neck can come down to shield them
I will not strike first

lines.zh: 你把那东西举低点，孩子们怕
lines.en: Lower that thing; the little ones are scared.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不看你脸
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就挡一步
lines.en: One step from you, one step of mine to block
They are behind me
What is it you want to do
My temper is not bad, but I have a limit
You are not carrying a weapon, are you
All our young are watching you
I took a hit on the flank
The young ones are calling
There is a wound on my flank

lines.zh: 我把它拖到我身子后面
lines.en: I drag it behind my bulk
I do not retreat, but I am hurting
I scuff the ground with my foot

lines.zh: 我腿上开了口子，草染红了
lines.en: A gash opens on my leg and reddens the grass.
I lower myself to guard my belly
I bite a stem and hold
I look up to see if it is still there
What is it you are lifting

lines.zh: 你举着它，孩子们都看见了
lines.en: You hold it up and the young ones have all seen
They want it, I will not allow it
This is not enough to share
Set it down on the ground first
Let me smell it
This thing is too sweet
My young cannot eat this
Step back a bit and I will look again

lines.zh: 我把它踢给最近的那只
lines.en: I kick it to the nearest one
You bumped my leg

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的脚没挪半寸
lines.en: You run into me and my feet don't shift an inch.
My young got a fright
I block you with my body

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我比你重得多
lines.en: We collided, I am far heavier

lines.zh: 我低头看你有没有受伤
lines.en: I lower my head to see if you are hurt

lines.zh: 我让开一步，眼睛没离开你
lines.en: I step aside without taking my eyes off you.
That put me on guard

lines.zh: 我肩膀一送，把你挪开半步
lines.en: One push of my shoulder moves you half a step.
Our young are both watching

lines.zh: 我这一生只守着一个巢
lines.en: I keep one nest all my life
My mate is not far
Eggs in the nest are enough
This is common among my kind
I lower my head to touch its neck
We watch the young together
I stand between it and the world
This is simply how we live
I turn slowly away
I go on leading the line
I carry it to the young
The young can eat this
I set it among them
I inspect what is on the ground first
I nudge it forward with my snout
Too hard, they cannot bite it
I press it into the mud
This is not enough to share
I carry it a short way
I have set it down
Something is nearing the line
I lift my head that way
I herd the young toward the middle
My neck has gone taut

lines.zh: 我把身子横在它们和我之间
lines.en: I set my body between them and the threat.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里挤出一声低吼
lines.en: I squeeze a low rumble out of my throat.
They are huddled behind me
I can reach at this distance

lines.zh: 我低下头，把冠子朝向前方
lines.en: I lower my head and point my crest forward.
The grass over there is moving

lines.zh: 我站起来，把孩子们往后拨
lines.en: I stand and push the young ones back
This one does not look like a grazer
I lowered my neck
My patience goes only this far

lines.zh: 我慢慢逼近，一步也不快
lines.en: I close in slowly, never rushing a step.

lines.zh: 我的体型就是我的底气
lines.en: My bulk is my confidence
It circles, I turn with it

lines.zh: 我把身体挡在它和孩子之间
lines.en: I keep my body between it and the young
My feet are planted firmly
I wait for it to withdraw
I do not like fighting
But I will not yield the path
My tail swept once
Get closer and I charge
I keep facing it
It is testing how far I go

lines.zh: 我把前脚钉在地上不动
lines.en: I plant my forefeet and hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我听见小的们在后面喘
lines.en: I hear the young panting behind me
It has fallen back half a step
I drive my shoulder in
I lower my head and connect
Not vicious, but very heavy
I have blocked its path

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过去，扬起一片草屑
lines.en: My tail sweeps by and kicks up a spray of grass.
I push it away from the line

lines.zh: 我站着不动，它自己退了
lines.en: I stand still and it backs off on its own

lines.zh: 我的前脚压住了它的脚
lines.en: My forefoot pins its foot

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，孩子们就缩起来
lines.en: I call out and the young ones crouch
I scrape away a layer of soil

lines.zh: 我这下是给孩子们看的
lines.en: This one is for the young to see

lines.zh: 我的头一顶就把它推出去
lines.en: One push of my head sends it away

lines.zh: 我把它撞出队伍的范围
lines.en: I knock it clear of the line
I am breathing very loudly

lines.zh: 我带着一群小的走出来
lines.en: I walk out with a group of young
The water and grass are both good here

lines.zh: 巢就在坡下，我得看着它
lines.en: The nest is down the slope, and I must keep an eye on it.
I call the young ones to my side

lines.zh: 我的体重比我看起来的轻
lines.en: I am lighter than I look
I can run, but not today
There is no scent of ours here
I walk slowly into the grass
I look back and count once
The young ones all follow me

lines.zh: 我踩进这片草地，草被压平
lines.en: I step into the grass and it flattens

lines.zh: 我的孩子们跟在我后面
lines.en: My young follow behind me

lines.zh: 我们走了很远才到这里
lines.en: We came a long way to reach here

lines.zh: 我的头抬得很高，看得清远处
lines.en: I hold my head high to see far

lines.zh: 这里的地很软，适合小的跑
lines.en: The ground is soft here, good for the young to run
My call is not loud

lines.zh: 我闻到草的味道和水汽
lines.en: I smell grass and water in the air
We rest here a while
Fire seared my neck

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下来，砸在地上
lines.en: I slid down the slope and hit the ground
Water reached my back

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得横移了几步
lines.en: The blast shoves me a few steps sideways.
An arrow stuck on my shoulder bone

lines.zh: 那股术力穿过我的骨头
lines.en: That magic passed through my bones
I have not fed, my milk will thin
Lightning struck my back
The grass under me is gone
